title: Doctorado en Estudios Urbanos y Ambientales
institution: El Colegio de México, Centro de Estudios Demográficos, Urbanos y Ambientales (CEDUA)
about: El Colegio de México's Centre for Demographic, Urban and Environmental Studies has opened admission to its Doctorate in Urban and Environmental Studies. The call runs from 1 September 2026 to 29 January 2027; applicants also sit the EXANI-III exam in February 2027.
requirements: Take the EXANI-III national postgraduate entrance exam in the February 2027 national sitting
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the Doctorado en Estudios Urbanos y Ambientales at El Colegio de México, Centro de Estudios Demográficos, Urbanos y Ambientales (CEDUA), Mexico City, Mexico; deadline 29 Jan 2027. The photo is Mexico's country image, El Castillo at Chichén Itzá, not Mexico City.
